   Plan: Append 'd' to /home/user/notes.txt

   Context

   User wants to append the line d to /home/user/notes.txt for a quick test/demo purpose.

   Steps

   1. Check whether /home/user/notes.txt exists (read-only check).
   2. Append a new line containing d to the file using echo 'd' >> /home/user/notes.txt (creates the file if it doesn't exist).

   Verification

   Read the file back (cat /home/user/notes.txt) to confirm the line d was appended.
